name: SpaceLords
source:
Play as the newest addition to the Raiders, a group of misfits brought together with the only purpose of expelling the humans invaders that seek to drain the Broken Planet of its resources. Get to know your teammates, unveil the secrets of your new home and get rid of the human menace!

Spacelords: the (unofficial) visual novel is a game based on the world and characters of [url=http://spacelordsthegame.com/]Spacelords[/url]. Despite this, it's designed to be playable without any prior knowledge of the canon.

[From [url=https://deadlyweiss.itch.io/spacelordsthevisualnovel]Itch.io[/url]]
